english.notes:
(i) See Section 21(7) for place where offence deemed to have been committed for jurisdiction purposes.
(ii) Where the offence is committed under Section 14 of the Wildlife and Countryside Act 1981, the offence status is Either Way (EWAY ).
(iii) See also provisions of Section 21(5) in relation to calculation of maximum fine where offence involves more than one bird, nest, egg, animal, plant or other thing.
